title: Hermanus Country Market
summary: Hand-made, home-made, local: a Saturday market at the Hermanus Cricket Club, open every Saturday, year round, from 9am to 2pm.
description: Discover the vibrant charm of the Hermanus Country Market, where community, creativity, and connection come together every Saturday from 9 AM to 2 PM. Handmade | Homegrown | Local – From fresh produce and handcrafted goods to artisan foods and unique gifts, every stall tells a story of passion and craftsmanship. Pet-Friendly & Family-Friendly – Bring the whole family (furry friends included!) to enjoy a lively, welcoming atmosphere. Kids will love the Kiddies’ Corner, jungle gym, and open play spaces. A Feast for the Senses – Enjoy great music, gourmet treats, fresh flowers, lush plants, and stunning artisanal creations in a bustling, open-air setting. We have over 60 traders showcasing a wonderful selection of locally-produced goods, from fresh farm vegetables and artisan breads to delicious prepared foods and pastries.

venue.name: Hermanus Cricket Club
venue.address: Corner of Fairways Avenue & Jose Burman Drive, next to the Generations School

profile: A weekly open-air Saturday market at the Hermanus Cricket Club with over 60 traders selling fresh produce, artisan breads, prepared food, crafts, jewellery and clothing. Visitors shop, eat on site and listen to live music, and children have a Kiddies' Corner and jungle gym. It suits families, pet owners and anyone looking for local food and handmade gifts on a Saturday morning.

title: Hermanus Country Market Summer Night Markets
summary: In December and January the Hermanus Country Market also holds its popular Summer Night Markets from 5pm to 9pm on Wednesday evenings.
description: In December & January we also hold our popular Summer Night Markets from 5pm to 9pm on Wednesday evenings.

venue.name: Hermanus Cricket Club
venue.address: Corner of Fairways Avenue & Jose Burman Drive, next to the Generations School

profile: An evening edition of the Hermanus Country Market held on Wednesdays in December and January, from 5pm to 9pm. Visitors browse the market's local food and craft stalls on a summer evening. It suits holidaymakers and families in Hermanus over the festive season.
